ns2:course.label: Small Animal Emergency Med
ns2:course.description: This is a two week elective rotation dedicated to emergency medicine. Students will work with the primary receiving clinician in the ER. Students will be responsible for seeing incoming emergency case duties to include: history taking, physical examination and consultation with the clinician. This rotation is designed to give the student exclusive time in the ER to allow for more case exposure and better opportunities for hands-on learning. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 4.5 hours. Prerequisite: Limited to third and fourth year clinical DVM students.
